deliveryCheck.subject: CrewPoint email check
deliveryCheck.text:
Hello {{name}},

This is a test email from CrewPoint, sent to check that email reaches you and your {{word.group.one.lower}}. You don't need to do anything.

CrewPoint
deliveryCheck.push: A test email from CrewPoint is on its way.

signInLink.subject: Your CrewPoint sign-in link
signInLink.text:
Hello,

Tap this link to sign in to CrewPoint and carry on where you left off:

{{link}}

The link works once and expires in an hour. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email; nobody can sign in without it.

CrewPoint
signInLink.push: Your CrewPoint sign-in link is in your email.

registrationConfirmation.subject: You're registered for {{eventTitle}}

registrationWaitlisted.subject: You're on the waitlist for {{eventTitle}}
registrationWaitlisted.push: You're on the waitlist for {{eventTitle}}, number {{position}}.

waiverMissing.subject: A waiver is waiting for {{eventTitle}}

registrationOffer.subject: A place is available for {{eventTitle}}
registrationOffer.text:
Hello,

A place has opened up at {{eventTitle}} for your {{word.group.one.lower}}. It's held for you until {{until}}.

Accept your place here:

{{link}}

If you can't come, you can say No thanks on the same page, so the place goes to the next on the waitlist.

CrewPoint
registrationOffer.push: A place is available for {{eventTitle}} until {{until}}.

registrationOfferExpired.subject: Your offer for {{eventTitle}} has expired
registrationOfferExpired.text:
Hello,

The place we held for your {{word.group.one.lower}} at {{eventTitle}} wasn't accepted by {{until}}, so it has gone to the next on the waitlist. You're still on the waitlist, now at the end of the queue.

See your {{word.registration.one.lower}} here:

{{link}}

CrewPoint

registrationClosing.subject: Registration for {{eventTitle}} closes soon
registrationClosing.text:
Hello,

You started a {{word.registration.one.lower}} for {{eventTitle}} but haven't sent it yet. Registration closes {{closes}}.

Finish it here:

{{link}}

CrewPoint
